headline: HuyenBao v11.51 — mobile layout fixes + Assets tab reordered (owned first)
summary: MOBILE UX PASS. Tooltips (the stuck 'phong thuy +2' popup) now only show on hover-capable devices — touch screens no longer leave them open after a tap. Modal popups tightened for mobile (padding 16px → 6px, max-width 100%, smaller header/body padding, full-width footer buttons). Asset section tabs scroll horizontally on mobile instead of wrapping. Cash chip + PinZone chips shrink to fit narrow screens. Biz-actions buttons go full-width on mobile. Toast font/padding reduced on mobile so long notifications don't dominate. Assets tab reordered: 'Owned' is now the first section (was 4th, after bds/lux/budget), and the tab opens on the player's portfolio by default instead of the buy catalogue.
features: FIX: tooltips wrapped in @media (hover: hover) — touch devices no longer show the stuck popup after a tap (was the 'phong thuy +2' tooltip bug)
FIX: modal-overlay padding tightened 16px → 6px on mobile so popups fill more screen
FIX: modal-box + gigs-modal max-width forced to 100% on mobile (was 440px / 560px, could overflow)
FIX: modal-head/body/foot padding reduced on mobile; footer buttons go full-width with flex:1
FIX: asset-section tabs (.asec) scroll horizontally on mobile like gnav/subnav (no more 2-row wrap)
FIX: cash-chip + pchip + hpill shrink on mobile so PinZone agehead fits better
FIX: biz-actions buttons go full-width on mobile (flex:1, wrap cleanly)
FIX: toast font + padding reduced on mobile so long notifications don't dominate the screen
FIX: avatar-picker 5 cols on narrow screens (was 6, cramped); edit-preview avatar smaller
REORDER: Assets tab sections now: Own → Real estate → Luxury → Budget → Auctions → Rare → Workshop (was bds → lux → budget → own → ...)
REORDER: Assets tab default section is now 'own' (player's portfolio) instead of 'bds' (buy catalogue)
